## 問題
2025 年 1 月份的有效訂單總數為多少？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 4098
採用的定義與依據: 有效訂單採語意層定義，即訂單狀態為 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達），並以不重複訂單編號計數。訂單時間 order_ts 為 UTC，已先加 8 小時換算為台北時間，再篩選 2025-01-01 至 2025-01-31 的訂單。
SQL 1: ["SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-02-01 00:00:00'", "SELECT order_ts, status, datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours') AS tpe_ts FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 5"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-02-01 00:00:00'", 'columns': ['valid_orders'], 'rows': [[4098]], 'truncated': False}, {'query': "SELE

## 回答 B
最終答案: 4089
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層「有效訂單」定義，取 orders.status 為 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達）的訂單，並以 DISTINCT order_id 計張數。時間條件為 order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < '2025-02-01'；order_ts 全表皆為 19 字元的統一格式，字串比較可靠。
SQL 1: SELECT order_ts, status FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 5
  結果: {'columns': ['order_ts', 'status'], 'rows': [['2024-12-30 00:03:20', 3], ['2024-12-30 00:13:54', 3], ['2024-12-30 00:17:31', 3], ['2024-12-30 00:25:59', 3], ['2024-12-30 00:28:46', 3]], 'truncated': False}
SQL 2: ["SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders_2025_01 FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < '2025-02-01'", "SELECT LENGTH(order_ts) AS ts_len, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY LENGTH(order_ts)"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders_2025_01 FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < '2025-02-01'", 'columns': ['valid_orders_2025_01'], 'rows': [[4089]], 'truncated': False}, {'query': 'SELECT LENGTH(order_ts) AS ts_len, COUNT(*) AS n F

response: {"winner": "A", "reason": "A 明確指出 order_ts 為 UTC 並換算成台北時間（+8 小時）再篩選 1 月，B 直接以 UTC 字串篩選、未處理時區，月份邊界可能錯置，導致 4089 與 4098 的差異。", "critical_error": "B"}
